seattle_accessible_shower_bathroom.label: Bathroom Remodel
seattle_accessible_shower_bathroom.heading1: Accessible Shower Bathroom Remodel in Seattle
seattle_accessible_shower_bathroom.text1: This bathroom was designed to work well every day and feel good to walk into. The shower, double wood vanity, and small patterned floor tile give the room a useful layout with a little warmth. Natural light from the window helps keep it open and bright. Each area has a clear purpose, so the room feels comfortable without being crowded.
seattle_accessible_shower_bathroom.short2: Accessible Shower Bathroom Remodel in Seattle
seattle_accessible_shower_bathroom.text2: The warm wood vanity gives the room character and a natural finish. Two sinks give people room to get ready at the same time, and the small patterned floor tile adds detail without competing with the wood.
seattle_accessible_shower_bathroom.text3: The large tile gives the shower a clean, quiet look. Two sides are glass from top to bottom, the clear shower wall and the window, so daylight fills the space.
